title: In Vivo Investigation of Root Extract of Paederia foetida Linn. on the Reproductive Functions of Female Albino Mice and In Silico Validation With Human Estrogen Receptors.
authors: Mili, Sivani; Phonglo, Ambalika; Begum, Taslema; Singh, Yungkham Rajeevkumar; Kalita, Jogen Chandra
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Paederia foetida根提取物对小鼠生殖功能的影响，并用分子对接验证植物化合物与人雌激素受体的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Ethnic Mising women of northeast India uses the dried root of Paederia foetida Linn. for fertility regulation. However, there is no scientific literature regarding female reproductive concerns so far. Therefore, this study was undertaken to know the phytocompounds present in the root of P. foetida and investigate the effect of P. foetida on the estrous cycle, ovarian, and uterine histoarchitecture. Methanolic root extract (MRE) was prepared at the doses 250 and 500 mg/kg bw (compared to 17beta-estradiol as a reference drug) and was tested in ovary-intact mice for 21 days. MRE at 500 mg/kg bw-treated mice resulted in degenerative ovarian histoarchitecture with a significant increase (p < 0.05) in atretic follicles and a significant decrease (p < 0.05) in a number of endometrial gland and disruptive reproductive hormones. Compounds like stigmasterol, having profound antifertility agents, were found in the GC-MS analysis. As per molecular docking, the phytocompounds that showed the highest binding affinity were gamma-sitosterol (-11.25 kcal/mol) and ergosterol (-12.92 kcal/mol) against human estrogen receptor alpha and beta (hERalpha and hERbeta), respectively. This study is the first-ever report of P. foetida roots extract on reproductive parameters and compounds of P. foetida showing binding affinity with hER. This study provides scientific evidence that supports the traditional usage of P. foetida Linn. for fertility regulation, which will further help in the standardization and development of drugs for fertility control.
abstract_zh: 印度东北部的米辛族女性使用鸡矢藤（Paederia foetida Linn.）的干燥根部进行生育调节。然而，迄今为止，关于女性生殖问题的科学文献尚属空白。因此，本研究旨在了解鸡矢藤根部所含的植物化合物，并探讨鸡矢藤对发情周期、卵巢及子宫组织架构的影响。制备了甲醇根部提取物（MRE），剂量为250和500 mg/kg体重（以17β-雌二醇作为参考药物），并在卵巢完整的雌性小鼠中测试21天。经500 mg/kg体重MRE处理的小鼠表现出退行性卵巢组织架构，伴有闭锁卵泡显著增加（p < 0.05）、子宫内膜腺数量显著减少（p < 0.05）以及生殖激素紊乱。气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析发现，如豆甾醇等具有显著抗生育活性的化合物。分子对接结果显示，植物化合物中结合亲和力最高的为γ-谷甾醇（-11.25 kcal/mol）和麦角甾醇（-12.92 kcal/mol），分别针对人雌激素受体α和β（hERα和hERβ）。本研究首次报道了鸡矢藤根部提取物对生殖参数的影响，以及鸡矢藤化合物与人雌激素受体的结合亲和力。本研究为鸡矢藤用于生育调节的传统用途提供了科学证据，这将进一步有助于生育控制药物的标准化和开发。
